# It’s your meeting. Bring context into Claude, ChatGPT, and the AI tools you use.

Fathom’s AI meeting notetaker MCP server connects your meeting data to Claude, ChatGPT,  and other MCP-compatible tools, so your AI assistant can answer questions and draft work from what was actually said.

sign up free

Stop pasting summaries and transcripts into chat to get context.

Ask your AI assistant about any meeting you can access in Fathom.

Combine meeting context with your docs, plans, and other connected tools.

### Ask your assistant about your meetings.

Ask Claude what a customer pushed back on last week, or have ChatGPT pull the decisions from Monday’s planning call. Your assistant retrieves the context from Fathom directly, so you’re not hunting for the right summary to paste in.

### Turn meeting context into finished work.

Ask Fathom answers questions inside Fathom. MCP brings the same meeting context into the assistant where you’re already drafting, so a recap email, QBR narrative, or launch brief starts from what was said, right alongside your docs and other connected tools.

### Connect in a few steps, on the permissions you already have.

Add the Fathom app in ChatGPT or the Fathom connector in Claude, or point any MCP-compatible tool at Fathom’s MCP server and sign in. Your assistant can only reach meetings you can already view in Fathom. MCP doesn’t open up any new data.

## Works where you work

Fathom syncs meeting insights automatically with the tools your team uses. Zero friction, maximum flexibility.

See all integrations

## Related features

### Fathom API

For building your own workflows and apps on meeting data, with webhooks and TypeScript and Python SDKs.

see fathom api

### Ask Fathom

For asking questions of your meetings inside Fathom, across one call or your team’s meeting history.

see ask fathom

### Highlights

For marking the moments that matter so they’re easy to find, share, and reuse.

see highlights

## FAQs

Questions? We’ve got you covered.

### What is an AI meeting notetaker MCP server?

An AI meeting notetaker MCP server connects your meeting notes to AI assistants using the Model Context Protocol. Fathom’s MCP server lets Claude, ChatGPT, and other MCP-compatible tools answer questions and draft work from what was actually said in your meetings.

### Which AI tools work with Fathom MCP?

Fathom MCP works with ChatGPT (through the Fathom app), Claude (through the Fathom connector or Claude Code), and any MCP-compatible tool using the server URL https://api.fathom.ai/mcp.

### How do I connect Fathom to Claude or ChatGPT?

Add the Fathom app in ChatGPT or the Fathom connector in Claude, or point any MCP-compatible tool at Fathom’s MCP server and sign in with your Fathom account.

### Which meetings can my AI assistant see?

Your AI assistant can access only the meetings you have permission to view in Fathom. MCP doesn’t open up any new data.

### Is Fathom MCP free?

Yes. Fathom MCP is available on every Fathom plan, including Free. Your AI assistant’s own plan requirements may apply.

### How is Fathom MCP different from Ask Fathom?

Ask Fathom answers questions inside Fathom. Fathom MCP brings the same meeting context into the AI assistant where you’re already working, alongside your docs and other connected tools.

### Can I use Fathom MCP in Claude Code?

Yes. Add the Fathom MCP server in Claude Code to reference customer calls and meeting decisions while you build.

### What can I do with Fathom MCP?

Draft QBR narratives, mutual action plans, battlecards, launch messaging, and product requirements from real meeting context, or ask your assistant what a customer pushed back on last week.

Never miss what matters

### Stop pasting summaries into chat. Start working from what was said.

### **Start today, for free.**

Get Started. It’s Free.

## Claude (web & desktop)

Fathom is available as an **official connector** in Claude:

### Steps:

1. Go to the **Fathom connector for Claude**.

If you’re using Claude in a team or organization, an owner must first enable the connector before it will appear for members.

2. Click **Connect** and complete the authorization prompts.

That’s it! You can now ask Claude about your meetings.

## Claude Code

Claude Code supports adding MCP servers directly from the command line.
Run the following command in your terminal:

```
claude mcp add fathom -- npx mcp-remote@latest https://api.fathom.ai/mcp
```

The Fathom MCP server will now be available in your Claude Code sessions.
